description: Two logic sections in 4HP, each comparing two inputs and giving all six results at once, with optional signals to pass instead of fixed levels

params.text: Inverts that input before the comparison while it is pressed

inputs.text: The signal passed by any output of either section that comes out true; with the jack empty a true output carries the level set on the menu
The signal passed by any output of either section that comes out false; with the jack empty a false output carries the level set on the menu
One of the two signals the upper section compares, counted as high at 1V or more
The first signal the lower section compares; with the jack empty it reads the upper section's OR result
The second signal the lower section compares; with the jack empty it reads the upper section's AND result

outputs.text: Carries the true signal while both of that section's inputs are high, and the false signal otherwise
Carries the true signal unless both of that section's inputs are high
Carries the true signal while at least one of that section's inputs is high, and the false signal otherwise
Carries the true signal while neither of that section's inputs is high
Carries the true signal while exactly one of that section's inputs is high, and the false signal otherwise
Carries the true signal while that section's two inputs match, high or low

notes: patching a signal into the True input and leaving False empty turns any output into a mute: the signal passes while the comparison holds and 0V comes out when it does not
the lower section chains from the upper one unless you patch it: C reads A OR B and D reads A AND B, which the arrowheads on the panel show
menu: True output level — sets the voltage a true output carries when the True input is empty, 10V unless you change it
False output level — sets the voltage a false output carries when the False input is empty, 0V unless you change it
Clipping range — clamps every output to the range chosen, -12V to 12V unless you change it, and Off lets the output run to any voltage
Process quality: Audio, High, Balanced, Low, Very low — sets how often the module runs its algorithm, from every cycle down to every 256th; below Balanced a 1ms trigger can be missed
Gate-high detect-level — sets the voltage at which an incoming gate counts as high, 1V or more unless you change it

inputs.0:
polyphonic

unpatched it reads the True output level from the menu.
inputs.1:
polyphonic

unpatched it reads the False output level from the menu.
inputs.2:
high above 1V · stepped · polyphonic

unpatched it reads 0V, read as low; a negative voltage does nothing here.
inputs.3:
high above 1V · stepped · polyphonic

unpatched it reads 0V, read as low; a negative voltage does nothing here.
inputs.4:
high above 1V · stepped · polyphonic

unpatched it reads the A OR B output; a negative voltage does nothing here.
inputs.5:
high above 1V · stepped · polyphonic

unpatched it reads the A AND B output; a negative voltage does nothing here.
